title: Synaptic Expression of TAR-DNA-Binding Protein 43 in the Mouse Spinal Cord Determined Using Super-Resolution Microscopy
authors: Matthew J. Broadhead; Katherine Doucet; Owen Kantelberg; Fei Zhu; Seth GN Grant; Mathew H Horrocks; Gareth B. Miles
one_liner_zh: 该文用超分辨显微镜研究小鼠脊髓突触中TDP-43的表达定位，属纯湿实验神经病理学，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cellular inclusions of hyperphosphorylated TAR-DNA-Binding Protein 43 (TDP-43) are a key hallmark of neurodegenerative diseases such as Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). ALS is characterised by a loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord that is preceded by early-stage changes in synaptic function that may be associated with TDP-43 pathology. However, there has been little characterisation of the synaptic expression of TDP-43 in spinal cord synapses. This study utilises a range of high-resolution and super-resolution microscopy techniques with immunolabelling, as well as an aptamer-based TDP-43 labelling strategy visualised with single-molecule localisation microscopy, to characterise and quantify the presence of phosphorylated TDP-43 (pTDP-43) in spinal cord synapses. We observe that TDP-43 is expressed in the majority of spinal cord synapses as nanoscale clusters as small as 60 nm in diameter. Synaptic TDP-43 expression is more frequently associated with presynaptic terminals than postsynaptic densities, and is more enriched in VGLUT1-associated synapses, compared to VGLUT2-associated synapses. Our nanoscopy techniques showed no difference in the subsynaptic expression of pTDP-43 in the ALS mouse model, SOD1 G93a compared to healthy controls. This research characterizes the basic synaptic expression of TDP-43 with nanoscale precision and provides a framework with which to investigate the potential relationship between TDP-43 pathology and synaptic pathology in neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract_zh: 过度磷酸化的TAR-DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）的细胞包涵体是神经退行性疾病（如肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS））的关键标志。ALS的特征是大脑和脊髓中运动神经元的丧失，其前兆是突触功能的早期阶段变化，这可能与TDP-43病理有关。然而，关于TDP-43在脊髓突触中的突触表达特征研究甚少。本研究利用一系列高分辨率和超分辨率显微镜技术结合免疫标记，以及基于适配体的TDP-43标记策略，并通过单分子定位显微镜可视化，来表征和量化脊髓突触中磷酸化TDP-43（pTDP-43）的存在。我们观察到TDP-43在大多数脊髓突触中以直径小至60纳米的纳米级簇形式表达。突触TDP-43表达更常与突触前末端相关，而非突触后密度，并且在VGLUT1相关突触中比VGLUT2相关突触中更富集。我们的纳米显微镜技术显示，在ALS小鼠模型SOD1 G93a中，pTDP-43的亚突触表达与健康对照组相比没有差异。本研究以纳米级精度表征了TDP-43的基本突触表达，并为探究神经退行性疾病中TDP-43病理与突触病理之间的潜在关系提供了框架。
